Name: Gil's Seasonal Anime Portraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
I Love using the anime portrait mods by Ohodavi in all my playthroughs of Stardew and recently we've been blessed with new portraits for characters who previously had none in Ohodavi's most recent update! Gil being one of them, I Decided to make Seasonal Outfit- Compatibility for this character!

I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well!

[color=#00ff00]Download Ohodavi's Original Work at[/color] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839[/url]

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits assets -> Portraits -> Gil, replacing the portraits originally from there.
